claims: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) is a senior-level U.S. agency.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) was established in 2004.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) oversees, integrates, and coordinates the 18 elements of the Intelligence Community (IC).
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) is led by the Director of National Intelligence (DNI).
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) ensures timely, objective intelligence to national leaders.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) manages the National Intelligence Program.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) leads the Intelligence Community (IC) to produce unified intelligence.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) leads the Intelligence Community (IC) through national centers focused on counterterrorism, counterintelligence, and cyber threats.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) develops and oversees the annual budget for the National Intelligence Program.
The Director of National Intelligence (DNI) acts as the primary intelligence advisor to the President, the National Security Council, and the Homeland Security Council.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) promotes sharing among intelligence agencies while protecting sources and methods.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) engages with the private sector to acquire cutting-edge technology and expertise.
The National Counterterrorism Center (NCTC) is a key component of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI).
The National Counterintelligence and Security Center (NCSC) is a key component of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI).
The National Counterproliferation and Biosecurity Center (NCBC) is a key component of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI).
The Cyber Threat Intelligence Integration Center (CTIIC) is a key component of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI).
The Foreign Malign Influence Center (FMIC) is a key component of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI).
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) was created following the 9/11 attacks.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.
